notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.53
notes.content:
[p]Hey Potato Gladiators![/p][p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b] – Various reported bugs have been fixed to improve your gameplay experience.
🎨 [b]UI Improvements[/b] – Menus and in-game UI are now smoother and clearer.

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.52
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

New Multiplayer Mode: Chariot Race Added! 🏆
Race through the arena in an intense chariot battle! Outspeed, outmaneuver, and outlast your enemies to claim victory.

🔧 Other Improvements:
- Bug fixes & optimizations
- Balance adjustments

 Get ready to ride into battle! 🏹🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/07bf3d681147a90e65b15e2567c2205a320b74bd.png[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.51
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

New Weapons Enter the Arena:
🗡️ Dagger: A throwable weapon for swift, deadly strikes.
🔥 Torch: Inflicts a fire damage debuff on enemies.
🔨 Hammer: Crush your foes with raw power.

Improvements:

🚀 Enhanced performance with optimization updates.
⚖️ Improved weapon and skill balance.

Jump in and test out the new weapons—victory awaits! 💥

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.5
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!
This major update introduces thrilling new content and game-changing features:

[b]Three Epic Bosses:[/b] 

Face off against the powerful Spud King,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/a50b3ca8abcba7ef26e00866fa0c00befab7917a.gif[/img]

Potato the Engineer,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/a3f4fb6053214eef9007d265b1ad6d25a196457e.gif[/img]

and the fearsome Dragon Lord.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/bd13a806ef5b0926e7123c09bcb09b728d7c642c.gif[/img]

[b]Skill Tree Expansion:[/b] The Agility and Melee Combat sections are now fully fleshed out, offering a complete set of skills to master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/dbf38439ddf1a5e6e308c21c448938f7a758ff49.gif[/img]

[b]New Stats System:[/b] Earn experience in the arena and permanently boost your character's Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, and Luck to dominate your foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/bf34db5fb93a53484046e3da72b269aab576aaaf.gif[/img]

Prepare to step into the arena like never before, where every battle tests your skills, strategies, and perseverance against an array of relentless foes. With the new v0.5 update, the stakes are higher, the enemies are fiercer, and the opportunities to grow stronger are more exciting than ever. 

Engage in intense, potato-powered combat and unlock your true potential as you conquer epic bosses, refine your abilities with the fully completed skill tree, and permanently enhance your stats to create the ultimate gladiator. This is your chance to claim glory and rise above the challenges in a world where every decision shapes your destiny. Let the arena light up with the clash of blades, the roar of victory, and the thrill of your journey!

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.49
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators! 🎣

Introducing [b]Fish Hunt[/b], an exciting [b]new multiplayer mode![/b] Up to 4 players can compete to catch as many fish as possible, with the best angler claiming victory and taking home all the coins.

Host your own server and choose whether to charge an entry fee or keep it free—winner takes it all! Ready your rod and show everyone who’s the real fishing master.

Get fishing and let the hunt begin! 🐟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/55ac67afb081d26f75a87f99dd67a190804e82d8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.48
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

In this update, I’ve introduced the game’s first boss, '[b]Potato the Sorcerer[/b]'! Along with that, there’s a new Vitality tab in the skills section, where you can unlock health-boosting and endurance skills, including [b]new health potions[/b]. Plus, I’ve made some optimization improvements and squashed a few bugs.

Thanks for playing, and keep growing stronger in the arena!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/0f37c0bfe2245a4beeb291b748f8263e97a63a04.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.47
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

In the latest v0.47 update, the powerful [b]Fire Book[/b] has been introduced! Unleash fiery mayhem by shooting fireballs at your enemies and watch them burn. This update also includes [b]optimization[/b] improvements and [b]bug fixes[/b], ensuring a smoother gameplay experience. Get ready to heat things up in the arena!

Thanks for sticking with me, and keep turning up the heat in the arena :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/8727ef60103b4b35bc8bd47de9df2f2ad46961a4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.46
notes.content:
[b]Hey, Potato Gladiators![/b]

v0.46 Update: [b]Ice Potion[/b] and [b]Power Stone[/b] have arrived! Freeze your foes with the Ice Potion or boost your weapons with the mighty Power Stone. Get ready to conquer the arena with these [b]new items![/b]

See you in the arena :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/491c9864d37b349dde609bca49a473f58e90ec06.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.45
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

In the latest [b]v0.45 update[/b], I’ve added an [b]Archery[/b] tab to the skills section. You can now unlock powerful new skills, including [b]Double Shot[/b], [b]Triple Shot[/b], [b]Ultra Shot[/b], [b]Power Shot[/b], and [b]Chain Strike[/b]. Enhance your combat abilities and take down enemies with precision!

Happy shooting :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/aecb8c9a0ecb5727272463f0ad9043152f69e0d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gladiato Potato Update v0.44
notes.content:
Hey Potato Gladiators!

I’m excited to announce that shields are now usable in the game! Equip a shield to protect your potato from enemy attacks and boost your defense. This update also includes several bug fixes to improve your gameplay experience.

Your support means the world to me. Keep enjoying 'Gladiato Potato' and stay tuned for more updates!

Thanks :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45093979/8fdf6f2629da8eb4c43b0a501be7e16b6b19c01f.png[/img]
